items.title: Safety

items:
Gorgeous, updated beach house with 4 bedrooms, 4 baths steps away from the beautiful beaches and crystal clear waters of the amazing Grayton Beach. Our home is newly renovated/furnished with a large, heated saltwater swimming pool and is within walking distance of multiple bars and restaurants.

The comfortable, remodeled beach home provides a one of a kind floor plan that allows for kids and parents to have their own space. Relax in the large living room or porch and have the kids play in the bonus room with a TV for movies and a TV for gaming. The fully equipped kitchen is open to the living and dining room. Lots of room for everybody!

The house features 3 large porches, one on each level. Enjoy beautiful views of the gulf and the rolling sand dunes of Grayton Beach from the upper porch. There are a total of 4 bedrooms and 4 baths - 2 br & 2 baths on the main floor and 2 br and 2 baths on the second floor. The home comfortably sleeps 12 with a (maximum of 8 adults) with 2 kings, 2 fulls, 2 sets of twin bunks and a LoveSactional that may be converted to a queen bed.

There is no better place than Sea La Vie to gather with family and friends and make beautiful memories. Please join us for an amazing vacation!

*** All renters MUST be 25 years of age and an occupant in the home during your stay

* Saturday to Saturday (7-day) rentals only from March through August, unless approved by management.

* October - April the pool may be heated at the request of the guest for an additional $200 for a 1 week stay.
*The Pool Heater requires 24 hours to reach the desired temperature of 83 degrees.
*Please let us know prior to your stay if you would like the pool heated and we will add to your reservation.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
